# Getting help

## Questions

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/smart-cleaning-robot/issues/new?template=question.yml). Check the [README](../README.md) and the [thesis](../docs/thesis/thesis.pdf) first; most build and wiring questions are answered there.

## Bugs

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/smart-cleaning-robot/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

## Security problems

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What I do not support

Builds that differ from the thesis hardware. I tuned the firmware gains and thresholds for this chassis, and I cannot debug other wiring or motors.
